items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: Tim, look back in your auto language matches, man.

ctx.x: Now there's something else some guys didn't know. Yeah. We had to play all that. We had to play saloon, pokers, mazookas and all that stuff. Chardis. Chardis. Chardis. Chardis. Chardis. Now you tell some of the guys about saloon, pokers right now, they don't know what you're talking about. Tim, look back in your auto language matches, man. You see all that stuff back in there. That's right, yeah.
